New alert: Payment gateway callbacks all rejected and orders stuck in pending. Service: payments-api, severity: SEV2.
Symptoms: Since about 09:00 UTC every callback from the payment gateway is rejected with a signature verification error; orders remain in 'pending' even though customers were charged.
Error: SignatureVerificationError: webhook signature mismatch

Evidence (only these incidents may be cited):
Incident INC-013 (payments-api, SEV2, 2026-07-06T12:15:38Z):
Symptoms: Payment gateway webhook events (payment.succeeded, payment.failed) all rejected with signature verification errors since ~12:00 UTC; order status stuck in 'pending'.
Root cause: The upstream payment gateway rotated its webhook signing secret as part of a scheduled security rotation; payments-api was still validating against the old secret cached in config.
Resolver: Priya Nair

Incident INC-004 (notification-service, SEV3, 2026-05-20T11:47:03Z):
Symptoms: Order confirmation and shipping emails delayed 15-40 minutes; SMTP send queue backing up.
Root cause: Primary transactional email provider's SMTP relay intermittently timed out on connect during a regional provider outage.
Resolver: Arjun Verma

Incident INC-015 (order-worker, SEV2, 2026-07-13T05:19:44Z):
Symptoms: Third Monday-morning Redis OOM; same signature as INC-003 and INC-008.
Root cause: Root-caused at last: the order-retry-queue's dead-letter keys were excluded from the TTL fix added in INC-008 due to a key-prefix mismatch (retry: vs order-retry:); those keys never expired.
Resolver: Ananya Iyer

Incident INC-002 (payments-api, SEV1, 2026-05-15T14:32:10Z):
Symptoms: payments-api p99 latency above 4.8s and checkout error rate above 23% starting ~12 minutes after the v2.3.0 Friday deploy; new checkouts failing with DB connection errors.
Root cause: The v2.3.0 deploy's new order-confirmation retry path opens a DB session per retry without releasing it on timeout, exhausting the 20-connection Postgres pool within minutes of Friday peak traffic.
Resolver: Priya Nair

Incident INC-021 (payments-api, SEV1, 2026-08-28T15:55:08Z):
Symptoms: Same signature as INC-002/INC-009/INC-017: p99 latency above 4.9s and checkout errors above 24% about 8 minutes after the v2.5.0 Friday deploy.
Root cause: Fourth occurrence of the same unfixed order-confirmation session leak, triggered by the v2.5.0 Friday deploy.
Resolver: Priya Nair

Incident INC-011 (auth-service, SEV3, 2026-06-29T08:41:17Z):
Symptoms: Google OAuth login failing intermittently for ~4% of attempts with upstream 500 errors.
Root cause: Google's OAuth token endpoint had a transient elevated error rate (confirmed via provider status page); auth-service had no retry/circuit breaker around the call.
Resolver: Emily Chen

Ranked fixes (use the top one as first_actions[0]):
  1. update_webhook_secret_from_vault (score=+0.667, worked=1, partial=0, failed=0, recent_failures=0)
